status: Development comparison protocol; empirical gates remain open
scope: The same four existing LG M50T fitted sample profiles, cell assignments, external current duty and heat-transfer assumptions are used in every design. These previously used models are not independent validation data.

options.name: Original connections
options.intervention: Same-end outputs and the declared thin copper links.

options.name: Thicker copper links
options.intervention: Double each internal link thickness from 0.08 to 0.16 mm. Contact resistance and output routes stay unchanged.

options.name: Opposite-end collection
options.intervention: Move the negative takeoff to Cell 4 and lengthen its external return route from 50 to 140 mm. The extra 90 mm is a declared routing assumption, independent of canvas pixels.

physical_assumptions: Rectangular fully dense copper; properties at 20 C from Copper Development Association Table 3. Dimensions and total contact resistances are declared scenarios, not measured joints. Routing losses are dissipated outside the cell thermal network. No conductor ampacity, insulation, enclosure, fatigue or fabrication clearance has been qualified.

scenarios.name: Cell 1 starts two percentage points lower
Cell 1 starts two percentage points higher
All cells start two percentage points lower
Half heat capacity and cooling together
Double heat capacity and cooling together
Half cooling at unchanged heat capacity

scenario_basis: Deterministic hypothetical sensitivity cases, including the prior audit's first-cell minus-two-percentage-point counterexample. These are not measured probability distributions, ageing predictions or confidence intervals. Thermal pair scaling preserves the isolated cooling time constant but changes forced heating.

priorities: Meet the declared 3.3 V output floor
Compare cell current and temperature stress against delivered energy and specified-conductor mass
decision.budget_meaning: Declared numerical comparison resolutions, not measured model accuracy or safety margins. Nominal refinement checks do not bound every perturbed scenario.
decision.recommendation_rule: Do not force a winner. Exclude incomplete duty or target violations from a full-service comparison. Show paired changes and ordering reversals. A physical recommendation requires the open cell, fixture and module empirical gates.
